id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

dataItem.description:
Read-only. The wrapped data object for the current row.
Property `obj` is an object containing data for the current row.

children.description: Read-only. The elements to render as children of this element.

columnProps.description: Read-only. Configuration of the column to which the cell belongs.

gridProps.description: Read-only. Configuration of the grid to which the cell belongs.

content.description:
Key for contentMap, iconMap, and colorMap.
If contentMap is not given or content is not in contentMap, content is displayed in pill

contentMap.description: Maps content field to text to display in pill

icon.description: If iconMap is not given or content is not in iconMap, given iconSuffix is displayed in pill

iconMap.description: Maps content field to iconSuffix of icon to display in pill

color.description: If colorMap is not given or content is not in colorMap, color field colors the pill

colorMap.description: Maps content field to color of pill

tooltip.description: Tooltip that appears when you hover on the pill component

onClick.description: If passed, the pill component will be clickable and this lambda will be called when pill is clicked
